name: Movie in the Park
raw: Movie in the Park | Sat Sep 26 dusk (~6:30-7pm) | Central Park Performance Pavilion | This event is FREE and no registration is required. Featuring The Bad Guys 2.

name: Grayslake Fall Fest
raw: Grayslake Fall Fest | Sat Oct 24 | Central Park Aquatic Fields | The first-ever Grayslake Fall Fest is an all-ages celebration featuring carnival rides, food trucks (available for purchase), hayrides, costume contest, face painting, live music. General admission free; some food/rides may be extra.
